description_en: Submits a modification request to update SMS qualification information. The qualification re-enters the review process after submission

fields.help_en:
The business certificate image. Only JPG, PNG, GIF, and JPEG formats are supported. The image size cannot exceed 5 MB. Specify the file path of the image uploaded to OSS. The file name cannot contain Chinese characters or special characters. For more information about the upload operation, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833114.html.

<notice>
Color originals of the certificate do not require a seal. If you upload a photocopy or a black-and-white photo, you must affix the official red seal of the enterprise on the photocopy and upload a photo of it.
</notice>
fields.help_zh:
营业证件图片，仅支持jpg、png、gif、jpeg格式的图片，图片不大于5MB。请填写上传到OSS的文件路径参数，待上传的文件命名不可包含中文和特殊字符，上传操作请参见通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833114.html。

<notice>
证件的彩色原件无需盖章，若上传复印件/黑白照片，需要在复印件上加盖企业红章并拍照上传。

businessLicense: Enterprise business license.

parameters.help_en:
The name of the administrator.

The administrator (also known as the handler) refers to the person who logs on to the Alibaba Cloud account and manages the SMS business. This is typically the operations personnel who manages the qualifications, signatures, and templates under the Alibaba Cloud account, sends SMS messages, and can receive verification codes on their mobile phone. The administrator is not necessarily the account administrator of the Alibaba Cloud account, and the administrator can be the same person as the legal representative of the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
管理员姓名。

管理员（又称经办人）指登录阿里云账号并管理短信业务的人员，一般是贵方管理此阿里云账号下资质、签名和模板，并进行短信发送的相关运营人员，且此人手机号可接收验证码。管理员不一定是此阿里云账号的管理员，管理员可以与企业法人为同一人

The mobile phone verification code. Call the [RequiredPhoneCode](~~RequiredPhoneCode~~) operation and pass in the administrator mobile phone number, and then enter the received SMS verification code here.

You can use [ValidPhoneCode](~~ValidPhoneCode~~) to verify whether the SMS verification code is correct before passing it in

手机号验证码。请调用[RequiredPhoneCode](~~RequiredPhoneCode~~)接口并传入管理员手机号码后，在此填入接收到的短信验证码。

您可以使用[ValidPhoneCode](~~ValidPhoneCode~~)自行校验短信验证码是否准确后再传入
